Operating highlights during the quarter included:


- Total assets increased to $16.6 billion from $13.2 billion as of March 31, 2026.
- Total customers across banking, brokerage, insurance and other segments rose to 9,272,000, compared to 8,106,000 as of March 31, 2026.
- On September 4, 2026, S&P Global Ratings revised the outlook on the long-term credit ratings of Freedom Holding Corp., Freedom Finance JSC ("Freedom KZ"), Freedom Finance Europe Limited ("Freedom EU"), Freedom Finance Global PLC ("Freedom Global"), and Freedom Bank Kazakhstan JSC (“Freedom Bank KZ") from “stable” to “positive,” while affirming their international credit ratings. The agency also raised the national-scale ratings of Freedom KZ and Freedom Bank KZ from “kzA-” to “kzA.”
- On September 4, 2026, Moody’s Ratings assigned insurance financial strength ratings to our two insurance subsidiaries for the first time. Freedom Insurance received Ba1 local- and foreign-currency insurance financial strength ratings, while Freedom Life received Baa3 ratings. Both carry stable outlooks. The Baa3 rating makes Freedom Life the first company within Freedom Holding Corp. to receive an investment-grade rating from Moody’s.


**Management Commentary**


“We continued to successfully execute on our strategy during the second quarter,” said Timur Turlov, Freedom Holding Corp. Chairman and CEO. “Our customer base grew to more than 9.2 million, with growth across banking, brokerage, and our other business segments. That is a net increase of approximately 1.2 million customers since March 31, 2026.


“Our financial results for the quarter reflect the investments behind that growth. Total assets reached $16.6 billion, and total revenue, net rose to $910.1 million from $503.6 million in Q2 a year ago. Net income rose to $46.1 million from $35.7 million in Q2 a year ago, as we continued to turn growth in customers and assets into higher net income.”


“We intend to keep executing the plan we have set out: expanding our ecosystem, strengthening our balance sheet and deepening relationships with the customers who rely on us.”


**Fiscal Second Quarter 2027 Financial Overview** *All comparisons are to the three months ended September 30, 2025, unless otherwise noted*


The Company reported total revenue, net, of $910.1 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026, an increase of 81% compared to $503.6 million for the same period in the prior year.


Fee and commission income for the three months ended September 30, 2026 was $148.5 million, reflecting an increase of $16.3 million, or 12%, compared to the same period in the prior year, mainly driven by higher agency fee income, banking services income and commission income from payment processing.


Interest income for the three months ended September 30, 2026 was $323.9 million, an increase of $112.3 million, or 53%, compared to the same period in the prior year. The increase was primarily attributable to an increase in interest income from margin loans and other loans to customers, together with increases in interest income from held-to-maturity securities, trading securities, available-for-sale securities, reverse repurchase agreements and amounts due from banks.


Net insurance revenue for the three months ended September 30, 2026 was $254.8 million, an increase of $152.0 million, or 148 **%,** compared to the same period in the prior year. The increase was primarily attributable to a $208.9 million increase in **** written insurance premiums, reflecting growth in the pension annuity portfolio, driven by a higher volume of new policies and related premium inflows, as well as a $21.7 million increase in deferred profit liability amortization. The increase was partially offset by a $73.5 million increase in deferred profit liability issuance expense.


Net gain on trading securities for the three months ended September 30, 2026 was $66.4 million, an increase of $29.3 million, or 79%, compared to a net gain on trading securities of $37.1 million for the same period in the prior year. The change was mainly attributable to gains from the sale of Kazakhstan sovereign debt securities, partially offset by an unrealized net loss on trading securities with respect to positions we held as of September 30, 2026.


Total expense for the three months ended September 30, 2026 was $859.9 million, an increase of $413.7 million, or 93%, compared to $446.2 million for the same period in the prior year. The increase was mainly attributable to increases in insurance claims and policyholder benefits, net of reinsurance, interest expense, payroll and bonus expenses, general and administrative expenses and advertising and sponsorship expenses.


Net income for the three months ended September 30, 2026 was $46.1 million, an increase of $10.4 million, or 29%, compared to $35.7 million for the same period in the prior year. Our Brokerage, Banking, Insurance, and Other segments contributed net income of $115.2 million, net income of $50.3 million, net income of $9.9 million and net loss of $129.4 million, respectively, to our total net income for the three months ended September 30, 2026.


Basic and diluted earnings per share were $0.77 and $0.76, respectively, compared to $0.60 and $0.58, respectively, for the same period in the prior year. Weighted average common shares outstanding used to compute diluted earnings per share for the three months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025 were 61.4 million and 61.1 million, respectively.


**Fiscal First Half 2027 Financial Overview** *All comparisons are to the six months ended September 30, 2025, unless otherwise noted*


The Company reported total revenue, net, of $1,643 million for the six months ended September 30, 2026, an increase of 60% compared to $1,028 million for the same period in the prior year.


Fee and commission income for the six months ended September 30, 2026 was $305.2 million, reflecting an increase of $65.4 million, or 27%, compared to the same period in the prior year, mainly driven by higher brokerage services income and higher agency fee income.


Net gain on trading securities for the six months ended September 30, 2026 was $146.2 million, an increase of $63.5 million, or 77%, compared to a net gain of $82.7 million for the same period in the prior year, mainly attributable to trading gains on sales of Kazakhstan sovereign debt securities and an increase in the value of securities positions.


Interest income for the six months ended September 30, 2026 was $619.1 million, representing an increase of $208.8 million, or 51%, compared to the same period in the prior year, reflecting an increase in interest income from margin loans and other loans to customers, as well as increases in interest income from trading securities, available-for-sale securities, held-to-maturity securities, reverse repurchase agreements and amounts due from banks.


Net insurance revenue for the six months ended September 30, 2026 was $378.9 million, an increase of $132.3 million, or 54%, compared to the same period in the prior year. Written insurance premiums increased by $206.9 million, or 69%, to $508.9 million, primarily due to significant planned growth in the pension annuity portfolio, driven by a higher volume of new policies and related premium inflows, in line with the Company’s strategic business development priorities.


Total expense for the six months ended September 30, 2026 was $1,552 million, an increase of $629 million, or 68%, compared to $923 million for the same period in the prior year, driven by higher interest expense, insurance claims and policyholder benefits, net of reinsurance, and payroll and bonuses.


Net income for the six months ended September 30, 2026 was $77.7 million, an increase of 6% compared to $73.1 million for the same period in the prior year. Basic and diluted earnings per share were $1.29 and $1.28, respectively, compared to $1.23 and $1.21, respectively, for the same period in the prior year. Weighted average common shares outstanding used to compute diluted earnings per share for the six months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025 were 61.3 million and 60.4 million, respectively.


**Additional Highlights**


On July 22, 2026, the Company acquired 100% of Wallet Solutions OÜ, a virtual asset service provider based in Estonia. The acquisition is in furtherance of the Company’s efforts to expand its digital asset capabilities and to integrate crypto-asset services into its ecosystem.


On July 31, 2026, we acquired 99.2% of Freedom Bank A.Ş. (formerly, Turkish Bank A.Ş.). The acquisition marks our formal entry into the Turkish banking sector and provides the banking foundation for an integrated financial and digital services platform in Türkiye.


On September 9, 2026, Freedom Kazakhstan Ltd., our subsidiary, acquired a 60% ownership interest in Bilim Group Ltd LLP, one of the largest education technology (EdTech) companies in Kazakhstan and Central Asia, founded in 2011. Bilim Group brings together IT services for the automation of educational processes and HR management, as well as digital libraries. The acquisition is a strategic step to develop EdTech services in Kazakhstan and Central Asia and to integrate them into the Freedom ecosystem.


On September 21, 2026, our subsidiary Freedom Finance Special Purpose Company LTD (“Freedom SPC”) issued $500 million U.S. dollar-denominated bonds due September 21, 2029 under its second $1 billion program, with 8.5% annual interest payable quarterly, of which $137.3 million were placed during the three months ended September 30, 2026.


On October 23, 2026, the Company and its wholly-owned subsidiary FRHC-IF.SPC Ltd. entered into an investment agreement with Kokzhiyek Fund LP (the **“** Fund **”** ), under which the Fund may subscribe for up to $1.16 billion in aggregate principal amount of bonds to be issued by FRHC-IF.SPC Ltd. in a private placement. Subject to applicable conditions, proceeds will be released in stages through December 30, 2028, to finance seven specified investment projects. The bonds are guaranteed by the Company, Freedom Kazakhstan Ltd. and Timur Turlov.


On November 10, 2026, FRHC-IF.SPC Ltd. received $700 million from the fund as payment for the bonds pursuant to the investment agreement. The funds were placed in an escrow account pending release.


*The securities will not be and have not been registered under U.S. Securities Act of 1933 (the “Securities Act”), and may not be offered or sold in the United States or to U.S. persons absent registration or an applicable exemption from the registration requirements of the Securities Act.*


**About Freedom Holding Corp.**


Freedom Holding Corp., a Nevada corporation, is a diversified financial services holding company that through its operating subsidiaries provides securities brokerage, securities dealing for customers and for our own account, market making activities, investment research, investment counseling, retail and commercial banking, insurance products, payment services information, processing services, education technology services and lifestyle services. Freedom Holding Corp. operates under the name Freedom or Freedom Finance in Europe and Central Asia, and Freedom Capital Markets in the United States. Through its subsidiaries, Freedom Holding Corp. employs more than 13,000 people and is a professional participant in the Kazakhstan Stock Exchange, the Astana International Exchange, the Republican Stock Exchange of Tashkent, International Trading System Limited, Armenia Stock Exchange, Kyrgyz Stock Exchange, the Uzbek Republican Currency Exchange and is a member of the New York Stock Exchange and the Nasdaq Stock Exchange.


Freedom Holding Corp.'s common shares are registered under the United States Securities Exchange Act of 1934 and are traded under the symbol FRHC on the Nasdaq Capital Market, on the Kazakhstan Stock Exchange and on Astana International Exchange. The Company’s main market of operations is Kazakhstan, and the Company has a presence in 27 countries.


To learn more about Freedom Holding Corp., visit[www.freedomholdingcorp.com](http://www.freedomholdingcorp.com/) .
